04 BEFORE YOU BRAVE IT

A FEW THINGS
TO KNOW.

Still have a question?
Give the team a call

View photo
What is The Fright Before Christmas?
It’s the Halloween and Christmas crossover event at Field of Screams Branson, running for four nights in November 2026. Think Christmas cheer with a Halloween twist.
When are the event nights?
November 6, 7, 13, and 14, 2026 — two Friday and Saturday weekends. Published attraction hours are 7 PM to 11 PM, with the box office opening at 6 PM. All times are Central Time. Check the official site for any schedule updates.
Where do I get tickets?
Use any ticket button on this page to open the Brushfire ticket window for current prices and availability. Saving a date to your calendar does not purchase a ticket.
Where is Field of Screams Branson?
Find us at Ballparks of America, 1000 Pat Nash Drive, Branson, Missouri 65616. Open directions.
Who can help with age guidance or accessibility?
Contact the Field of Screams Branson team before your visit for age guidance, accessibility questions, and group information. Call (417) 319-4555 or email info@fieldofscreamsbranson.com.
